args.body:
Hi June,

A few notes on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb. It is the same account, so please use the new name.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals", which is the old label. It is making people search twice, so it needs the Pellow Home Living name.
